purpose: Replace the stronger merged-tail extinction requirement on the pre-frontier critical path by a weaker frontier-localization theorem.

falsified_claims.claim: Every merged-tail birth dies immediately by post-local unit conflict.
falsified_claims.counterevidence: Seventeen cases die by causal post-unit contradiction, but one GT_4 case executes two UNSAT children without post-unit events.

falsified_claims.claim: The 13 ancestor conflict sources are exactly the 13 reason closures containing N_tail plus root transitivity.
falsified_claims.counterevidence: The equal aggregate counts do not align pointwise: the corrected causal/root cross-table contains ancestor cases without N_tail and direct cases with N_tail.

falsified_claims.claim: Merged-tail extinction must be proved before the historical frontier can be transferred.
falsified_claims.counterevidence: All eighteen finite merged-tail births occur with exactly two Hasse components at novelty n-2; none is born before the target.

proved_graph_lemma.name: Binary-Origin Two-Component Lemma
proved_graph_lemma.statement: If Resolution derives the unit clause (l) from binary parents (l OR p) and (l OR -p), and l is an external non-bridge in a component-spanning parent, then the Hasse-component quotient has exactly two vertices.
proved_graph_lemma.proof: The component-spanning parent has two edges. Deleting non-bridge l leaves a connected spanning graph with one edge, hence at most two quotient vertices. Since l is external, exactly two remain.

corrected_reason_cross_table.warning: Causal class and root ancestry are independent axes; equal marginal counts must not be identified pointwise.

new_arbitrary_n_gate.name: Merged-Tail Binary-Origin Reduction
new_arbitrary_n_gate.statement: Any fresh local resolvent that first contains a merged-tail non-tail bridge must satisfy the binary/binary-to-unit origin hypotheses, or belong to a separately proved base structural case. Therefore it is born only when two quotient components remain.
new_arbitrary_n_gate.counterexample_condition: A reachable fresh merged-tail bridge born with at least three Hasse components or from a wider pivot-dominated parent pair.

route_effect.retained_as_semantic_evidence: Seventeen causal contradiction reason DAGs and one GT_4 recursive extinction.
route_effect.remaining_global_gate: Transfer the historical 2^(n-2) restriction frontier to the exact Policy-0A cache DAG while charging unit joins, local proof events, terminal leaves, and cache reuse.

claim_boundary: The binary-origin graph lemma is proved and the localization is exhaustively certified through GT_8. The arbitrary-n binary-origin reduction, singleton-tail lexicographic handoff, global cache-frontier transfer, and P versus NP remain open.
